newsitem.title: CANADA: Southam to sell Construction Data Group.
newsitem.headline: Southam to sell Construction Data Group.

text.p: Southam Inc said on Tuesday it had a tentative agreement to sell Construction Data Group to CDG's management team and Boston Ventures.
Terms were not disclosed. The sale was expected to close on September 30.
Southam also said the sale of Southex Exhibitions, announced earlier this year, was also expected to close during the third quarter.
The company said both sales emphasize its strategy to focus on newspaper publishing.

Southam said it was alsolooking to sell its remaining assets in the Business Communications Group, including the Canadian Magazine Group, Canadian Information Products and American Trucker. -- Reuters Toronto bureau 416-941-8100
